product_goal: Монгол хэлтэй насанд хүрэгчид Чех хэлээр бодит ажлуудыг бие даан хийх

definitions.mission: Сэдэвт суурилсан гадаад нөхцөлийн зорилго; хичээл биш
definitions.skill: Тусгай ID-тай хэмжигдэх жижиг чадвар; хичээл биш
definitions.session: Суралцах 12–15 минутын нэг мөчлөг; агуулга, аудио, тест тусдаа бэлдэх ёстой
definitions.exit_task: Урьд нь давтаагүй бодит нөхцөлд өгөгдсөн зорилго биелснийг шалгах даалгавар

scale_warning: 72 mission is NOT 72 completed lessons. CEFR B2 is NOT guaranteed by completing 72 short sessions; independent calibrated integrated assessment is required. A0 has 140 existing micro-skill outline IDs and provisional 53 session groupings; A1–B2 only mission outcomes, no ready-to-teach lessons.

learning_principles.approach: CEFR action-oriented, context-first, active retrieval, spaced review, responsive feedback
learning_principles.reading_guidance: Advance word only on acceptable recognition or explicit assisted pathway. In guided word-reading mode speaker icon plays CURRENT stuck word only; never a global audio toggle.
learning_principles.safety: Never rely on speech-to-text transcription alone for Czech phonetic scores or real-world safety instruction.

gating.student_advancement: requires scored transfer task and review followup; not lesson click-through
gating.publication_policy: Do not set approved or published until real evidence covers all hard gates.
gating.pronunciation_review: Specialized vetted phonetic scoring or human review; STT transcript only confirms an approximate word match.
gating.safety_override: Wrong stop/warning command fails safety scenario regardless of aggregate points.
